visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young Asian men are seated on a light grey fabric sofa in a brightly lit indoor living room. The man on the left wears a black long-sleeved shirt with a white collared shirt and tie underneath, holding a white long-necked bird plushie. The man on the right wears a purple, white, and yellow color-blocked windbreaker jacket. The background is a simple off-white wall with a visible light switch and power outlet. (2) Animated Pokemon graphics (Sirfetch'd/蔥遊兵) appear as overlays in the center of the frame, accompanied by dynamic text boxes. The men gesture wildly with their hands, leaning toward each other and laughing with wide-mouthed expressions and squinted eyes. (3) The scene cuts between various medium shots of the two men as they continue their animated discussion. Graphic overlays change to show modified versions of the Pokemon, including icons of bombs and meat. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout. (4) One man leans back dramatically on the sofa while laughing, his body shaking. The other man points toward the camera or at the on-screen graphics. Yellow and green captions are persistent at the top and bottom of the frame. (5) A new Pokemon graphic (Audino/差不多娃娃) is introduced with a transition effect. The men react with even more intense facial expressions, including looks of shock and heightened hilarity. Red flame-like visual effects briefly overlay the frame for comedic emphasis during a loud exclamation. (6) The video concludes with the two men still on the sofa, clutching their stomachs and laughing uncontrollably, with a white star-shaped plushie visible on the right side of the couch.

Every time a new joke or graphic appears, a 'pop' or 'whoosh' SFX is triggered by the editor. The speakers' voices fluctuate between mid-range conversational tones and high-pitched excited shouting. (3) A loud vocal exclamation ('救命啊') creates a peak in volume and spectral intensity. The music continues uninterrupted, maintaining a steady 128 BPM rhythm.
